content_page.title: About us
content_page.body_md:
Annam Foods is a home-style Brahmin kitchen in **Triplicane, Chennai**.

Every day we cook breakfast, lunch and dinner to order, the way it is made at home. Alongside the daily menu we prepare podis, pakshanams, sweets, pickles, vathals and health mixes in small batches, packed fresh and shipped to your door.

For bookings and questions, message us on WhatsApp **95510 79550** or write to annamsfoods@gmail.com.
